Assign.description: The referenced entity record owner is changed.

Delete.description: The referenced entity record is deleted.

Merge.description: The record is merged with another record.

Reparent.description: The referencing attribute in a parental relationship changes

RollupView.description: Indicates that the associated activities of the related entity should be included in Activity Associated View for the primary entity.

Share.description: The referenced entity record is shared with another user.

Unshare.description: Sharing is removed for the referenced entity record.
